title: Amazon Is Creating the Biggest Pollution Source in the Entire Country
excerpt: Amazon has bought a site in Texas where it plans to build a data center campus.
content_html:
Amazon is quietly trying to build the biggest gas power plant in the country. 

The Distilled newsletter reported Friday that the megacorporation has bought land and acquired permits in Pecos County, Texas, for an AI data center powered by a 7.65 gigawatt gas power plant. The plant will be completely separate from Texas’s power grid, at least in the beginning, the permits show.  

The site, known as GW Ranch, got a state permit allowing the proposed power plant to emit 33 million tons of carbon dioxide, which would make it the biggest pollution site in the U.S., emitting more than the country’s biggest coal power plant, according to Distilled. That’s in sharp contrast to Amazon’s commitment to reach net-zero emissions by 2040 as part of The Climate Pledge.

Amazon filed three construction permits with the state of Texas this week to build three data center buildings immediately upon approval. Land clearing has already begun, according to satellite imagery. Amazon would join Microsoft, Google, and Meta in having its own off-grid gas power. 

Amazon says that it has 10 gigawatts of carbon-free energy across 40 projects to power its existing data center operations in Texas, and that the GW Ranch will use brackish groundwater that isn’t potable and thus can’t be used for irrigation or drinking. 

But that’s not likely to quell public opposition. Data centers are hugely unpopular across the country among Republicans and Democrats, both in rural and suburban areas. The centers don’t create many jobs or boost local economies. If connected to local power grids, they can drive utility rates up and cause black- and brownouts. Amid climate change and droughts, the claim that data centers will take advantage of unusable water will likely invite skepticism. 

The fact that Amazon is building its own power plant for the project will be a small comfort for residents worried about utility rates, but locals still will have concerns about pollution from a gas plant bigger than any other in the U.S. Rural Texas is deeply Republican, and despite President Donald Trump’s delusions about data centers’ popularity, opposition to them on the right is growing. Now that this project is public, a big backlash could soon follow.

Representative Max Miller blamed a daycare after his daughter was rushed to the hospital last year with bruises.

Miller sued a Westlake, Ohio, daycare provider in February 2025, after the daughter he shares with his ex-wife Emily Moreno (the daughter of Ohio Senator Bernie Moreno) was taken to an emergency room with injuries “on her thighs, face, groin, and vaginal area of her body and she was caused to incur psychological trauma.” Her mother took the girl, then under two years old, to a hospital on January 27 after a daycare staff member alerted police as well as the Department of Children and Family Services.

The lawsuit doesn’t clearly state where her injuries came from, and Miller has a long list of abuse allegations against him regarding his ex-wife and daughter, even allegedly fracturing his daughter’s collarbone. His lawsuit, filed four months before his divorce was finalized, accuses the school and four named employees of “failing to properly train and supervise their staff in the proper treatment of children in their care. Defendants abused and neglected a child dependent upon them for protection.”

Miller is the only person named in the complaint, and Moreno isn’t mentioned. Miller claims in the lawsuit that an investigation from county authorities backs up his claims, along with video and audio evidence documenting alleged abuse and neglect. The school denied the allegations, stating that the toddler was not “injured, brutalized, or harmed in any manner while under the defendants’ alleged care and supervision.”

The case was dismissed four months ago, and if there was a settlement, it hasn’t been disclosed. In light of newly revealed allegations that Miller has a habit of holding his daughter’s beloved blue bunny hostage and his admission that he shared an inappropriate photo of her online, this lawsuit raises even more questions.

Women accounted for 100 percent of the decline in the labor force in July, according to a National Women’s Law Center analysis of the Bureau of Labor Statistics’s latest dismal jobs report.

Overall, the economy lost 23,000 jobs in July: Women lost 32,000 jobs, while men gained 9,000. Many of the jobs lost were in local government and leisure and hospitality—real jobs that real women, who are already dealing with slowed wages and rising inflation, work.

Meanwhile, a whopping 165,000 women exited the work force last month, meaning they were neither working nor looking for a new job. The number of men in the labor force remained steady.

Jasmine Tucker, vice president of research at NWLC, warned that this latest jobs report was “not a sign of a healthy economy.”

“Women are leaving the labor force in alarming numbers, and many who remain employed are underemployed. This administration cannot celebrate an economy that is failing so many women,” Tucker said.

In fact, more than double the number of women have left the labor force than men since the start of the year. A total of 845,000 women have left the workforce since January, while 406,000 men have left.

It’s hard not to see these startling statistics as part of the Trump administration’s broader campaign to undermine women’s rights and autonomy.

Whether it’s making it harder for women to vote, sidelining women professionally, or endangering emergency pregnancy care—targeting women’s livelihoods just feels like part of the system that’s working as it was designed.

Marco Rubio is slowly choking Cuba to death.

The Secretary of State told Axios his plan to take over the island—long plagued by U.S. intelligence agency meddling and extensive federal sanctions—for good.

“What we’re trying to teach them is there are no escape valves … Every time they create a new mechanism in which they try to get out of the noose, we just close it off,” Rubio said. “They certainly can’t wait us out. Certainly this isn’t going to go away for the next [two and a half] years.”

The Trump administration has kept a constant thumb on Cuba, starting with a blackout-inducing oil blockade in January that has directly contributed to widespread food insecurity, economic collapse, and death, as infant mortality doubled on the island. The U.S. has levied 24 different attacks against Cuba, from accusing its doctor export program of human trafficking, claiming that it’s aiding international terrorism, and running an “irregular and covert” campaign against western ideologies. And military action is still a possibility.

“The Cuban Communist regime is a state sponsor of terrorism that spies on America, arms violent left-wing radicals, spreads poisonous Marxist ideology, and serves as a staging ground for Russia, China & Iran just 90 miles from our shores,” Rubio announced on Thursday. “Today I sanctioned five Cuban entities and eight individuals associated with procuring arms for the regime. As President Trump has said: The United States will not tolerate a rogue state harboring hostile military, intelligence & terror operations on our doorstep. Anyone supporting, sponsoring, or providing services to these sanctioned actors is at risk of being sanctioned themselves.”

The Trump administration (Rubio in particular) is leaning on Cold War, Red Scare rhetoric to justify perpetuating a full-scale humanitarian crisis in Cuba. On Thursday—the same day as Rubio’s announcement and four days after the most recent countrywide blackout—a panel of independent experts appointed by the Human Rights Council declared Cuba at risk of becoming a “silent Gaza.”

“The humanitarian consequences are already unfolding into a full-blown crisis, threatening the rights to health, to life, to food and to development.… Measures that knowingly deprive a population of the means to survive strike at the most basic guarantees of the rights to life and diminish the core of human dignity,” the report reads. “The U.S. Government must cease all threats and hostile acts against Cuba’s sovereignty and revoke all measures it has imposed on the country that stand contrary to international law.”

Editor’s Pick

President Donald Trump is seriously crashing out after a federal appeals court ordered him to stop illegal construction on his White House ballroom. 

In a furious screed on Truth Social Friday, Trump announced that he would immediately appeal the decision to the Supreme Court. 

“The Military and Secret Service are viewing this horrendous, politically motivated, and unlawful ruling as a National Security threat to our Nation in that the entire Complex is being built for the protection of our Country and, additionally, all future Presidents,” the president wrote.

Trump described his plans to build “one big, expensive, and very complex unit” that includes a state of the art hospital, bomb shelter, and a top secret military facility—well, not so secret anymore, I’d gather. 

In a 2-1 ruling earlier Friday, a  D.C. Circuit Court panel determined the Trump administration must seek approval for construction from Congress, which has the “exclusive authority to regulate the construction and demolition of White House structures.”

“At this preliminary stage, the National Trust has shown, compellingly, that Congress has not ceded unfettered authority to the Executive Branch to dramatically redesign, reshape, and reconstruct the White House—the People’s House—to fit a particular President’s desires,” the ruling stated. 

Trump-appointed Judge Neomi Rao dissented, agreeing with the administration that the National Trust for Historic Preservation did not have the standing to challenge the construction. The nonprofit’s case was centered around Professor Alison Hoagland, a member of the National Trust, who formally claimed that the ballroom was an aesthetic injury to the White House. 

Rao argued that the decision would “permit adjudication of any government action that a plaintiff finds unsightly.” But by the judge’s logic, the Trump administration could make unilateral sweeping changes to any national landmark—even, as the DOJ tried to claim, the Statue of Liberty. 

For months, Trump has treated the White House—which belongs to all Americans, not just the president—like one of his gaudy resort properties. 

Meanwhile, the price tag on Trump’s ballroom has exploded. The president originally claimed that his ballroom project would only cost $200 million, but that number later ballooned to $300 million, and then $400 million after he decided to tack on extra construction. In June, a bombshell report revealed that taxpayers would be expected to foot the bill for half of a $600 million total cost.

This story has been updated.

blocks.html_en: Women accounted for 100 percent of the decline in the labor force in July, according to a National Women’s Law Center analysis of the Bureau of Labor Statistics’s latest dismal jobs report.

sentences.en: Women accounted for 100 percent of the decline in the labor force in July, according to a National Women’s Law Center analysis of the Bureau of Labor Statistics’s latest dismal jobs report.
sentences.zh: 根据国家妇女法律中心对美国劳工统计局最新的惨淡就业报告的分析，7 月份劳动力下降的原因是女性 100%。

blocks.html_en: Overall, the economy lost 23,000 jobs in July: Women lost 32,000 jobs, while men gained 9,000. Many of the jobs lost were in local government and leisure and hospitality—real jobs that real women, who are already dealing with slowed wages and rising inflation, work.

sentences.en: Overall, the economy lost 23,000 jobs in July: Women lost 32,000 jobs, while men gained 9,000.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，7 月份经济损失了 23,000 个工作岗位：女性失去了 32,000 个工作岗位，而男性增加了 9,000 个工作岗位。

sentences.en: Many of the jobs lost were in local government and leisure and hospitality—real jobs that real women, who are already dealing with slowed wages and rising inflation, work.
sentences.zh: 失去的许多工作岗位来自地方政府、休闲和酒店业——这些工作是真正的女性所从事的，她们已经在应对工资放缓和通货膨胀上升的问题。

blocks.html_en: Meanwhile, a whopping 165,000 women exited the work force last month, meaning they were neither working nor looking for a new job. The number of men in the labor force remained steady.

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a whopping 165,000 women exited the work force last month, meaning they were neither working nor looking for a new job.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，上个月有多达 165,000 名女性退出劳动力市场，这意味着她们既没有工作也没有寻找新工作。

sentences.en: The number of men in the labor force remained steady.
sentences.zh: 劳动力中的男性人数保持稳定。

blocks.html_en: Jasmine Tucker, vice president of research at NWLC, warned that this latest jobs report was “not a sign of a healthy economy.”

sentences.en: Jasmine Tucker, vice president of research at NWLC, warned that this latest jobs report was “not a sign of a healthy economy.”
sentences.zh: NWLC 研究副总裁 Jasmine Tucker 警告说，最新的就业报告“并不是经济健康的迹象”。

blocks.html_en: “Women are leaving the labor force in alarming numbers, and many who remain employed are underemployed. This administration cannot celebrate an economy that is failing so many women,” Tucker said.

sentences.en: “Women are leaving the labor force in alarming numbers, and many who remain employed are underemployed.
sentences.zh: “正在以惊人的数量离开劳动力市场的女性，许多仍然就业的女性却就业不足。

sentences.en: This administration cannot celebrate an economy that is failing so many women,” Tucker said.
sentences.zh: 本届政府不能庆祝一个令如此多女性失望的经济，”塔克说。

blocks.html_en: In fact, more than double the number of women have left the labor force than men since the start of the year. A total of 845,000 women have left the workforce since January, while 406,000 men have left.

sentences.en: In fact, more than double the number of women have left the labor force than men since the start of the year.
sentences.zh: 事实上，自今年年初以来，离开劳动力市场的女性人数是男性的两倍多。

sentences.en: A total of 845,000 women have left the workforce since January, while 406,000 men have left.
sentences.zh: 自一月份以来，共有 845,000 名女性离开劳动力市场，而 406,000 名男性则离开劳动力市场。

blocks.html_en: It’s hard not to see these startling statistics as part of the Trump administration’s broader campaign to undermine women’s rights and autonomy.

sentences.en: It’s hard not to see these startling statistics as part of the Trump administration’s broader campaign to undermine women’s rights and autonomy.
sentences.zh: 很难不将这些令人震惊的统计数据视为特朗普政府破坏妇女权利和自主权的更广泛运动的一部分。

blocks.html_en: Whether it’s making it harder for women to vote, sidelining women professionally, or endangering emergency pregnancy care—targeting women’s livelihoods just feels like part of the system that’s working as it was designed.

sentences.en: Whether it’s making it harder for women to vote, sidelining women professionally, or endangering emergency pregnancy care—targeting women’s livelihoods just feels like part of the system that’s working as it was designed.
sentences.zh: 无论是让女性更难投票，让女性在职业上边缘化，还是危及紧急怀孕护理——以女性生计为目标，感觉就像是按照设计的那样运作的系统的一部分。

blocks.html_en: The Secretary of State told Axios his plan to take over the island—long plagued by U.S. intelligence agency meddling and extensive federal sanctions—for good.

blocks.html_en: “What we’re trying to teach them is there are no escape valves … Every time they create a new mechanism in which they try to get out of the noose, we just close it off,” Rubio said. “They certainly can’t wait us out. Certainly this isn’t going to go away for the next [two and a half] years.”

sentences.zh: “我们试图告诉他们的是，没有逃生阀……

sentences.en: Every time they create a new mechanism in which they try to get out of the noose, we just close it off,” Rubio said.
sentences.zh: 每次他们创建一种新机制试图摆脱绞索时，我们都会将其关闭，”卢比奥说。

blocks.html_en: The Trump administration has kept a constant thumb on Cuba, starting with a blackout-inducing oil blockade in January that has directly contributed to widespread food insecurity, economic collapse, and death, as infant mortality doubled on the island. The U.S. has levied 24 different attacks against Cuba, from accusing its doctor export program of human trafficking, claiming that it’s aiding international terrorism, and running an “irregular and covert” campaign against western ideologies. And military action is still a possibility.

sentences.en: The Trump administration has kept a constant thumb on Cuba, starting with a blackout-inducing oil blockade in January that has directly contributed to widespread food insecurity, economic collapse, and death, as infant mortality doubled on the island.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府一直对古巴保持着密切的关注，从一月份导致停电的石油封锁开始，直接导致了广泛的粮食不安全、经济崩溃和死亡，岛上婴儿死亡率翻了一番。

sentences.en: The U.S. has levied 24 different attacks against Cuba, from accusing its doctor export program of human trafficking, claiming that it’s aiding international terrorism, and running an “irregular and covert” campaign against western ideologies.
sentences.zh: 美国对古巴发动了 24 次不同的攻击，包括指责古巴的医生出口计划涉及人口贩运、声称古巴协助国际恐怖主义，以及针对西方意识形态开展“非常规和秘密”的行动。

sentences.en: And military action is still a possibility.
sentences.zh: 军事行动仍然是可能的。

blocks.html_en: “The Cuban Communist regime is a state sponsor of terrorism that spies on America, arms violent left-wing radicals, spreads poisonous Marxist ideology, and serves as a staging ground for Russia, China & Iran just 90 miles from our shores,” Rubio announced on Thursday. “Today I sanctioned five Cuban entities and eight individuals associated with procuring arms for the regime. As President Trump has said: The United States will not tolerate a rogue state harboring hostile military, intelligence & terror operations on our doorstep. Anyone supporting, sponsoring, or providing services to these sanctioned actors is at risk of being sanctioned themselves.”

sentences.en: “The Cuban Communist regime is a state sponsor of terrorism that spies on America, arms violent left-wing radicals, spreads poisonous Marxist ideology, and serves as a staging ground for Russia, China & Iran just 90 miles from our shores,” Rubio announced on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 卢比奥周四宣布：“古巴共产主义政权是恐怖主义的国家支持者，它对美国进行间谍活动，向暴力左翼激进分子提供武器，传播有毒的马克思主义意识形态，并成为距离我们海岸仅 90 英里的俄罗斯、中国和伊朗的集结地。”

sentences.en: “Today I sanctioned five Cuban entities and eight individuals associated with procuring arms for the regime.
sentences.zh: “今天，我制裁了与为该政权采购武器有关的五个古巴实体和八个个人。

sentences.en: As President Trump has said: The United States will not tolerate a rogue state harboring hostile military, intelligence & terror operations on our doorstep.
sentences.zh: 正如特朗普总统所说：美国不会容忍一个流氓国家在我们家门口窝藏敌对军事、情报和恐怖活动。

sentences.en: Anyone supporting, sponsoring, or providing services to these sanctioned actors is at risk of being sanctioned themselves.”
sentences.zh: 任何支持、赞助或向这些受制裁行为者提供服务的人都面临着受到制裁的风险。”

blocks.html_en: The Trump administration (Rubio in particular) is leaning on Cold War, Red Scare rhetoric to justify perpetuating a full-scale humanitarian crisis in Cuba. On Thursday—the same day as Rubio’s announcement and four days after the most recent countrywide blackout—a panel of independent experts appointed by the Human Rights Council declared Cuba at risk of becoming a “silent Gaza.”

sentences.zh: 特朗普政府（特别是卢比奥）正在依靠冷战和红色恐慌言论来证明古巴持续存在全面人道主义危机的合理性。

sentences.en: On Thursday—the same day as Rubio’s announcement and four days after the most recent countrywide blackout—a panel of independent experts appointed by the Human Rights Council declared Cuba at risk of becoming a “silent Gaza.”
sentences.zh: 周四，即卢比奥宣布这一消息的同一天，也是最近一次全国停电的四天后，人权理事会任命的一个独立专家小组宣布古巴面临成为“沉默的加沙”的风险。

blocks.html_en: “The humanitarian consequences are already unfolding into a full-blown crisis, threatening the rights to health, to life, to food and to development.… Measures that knowingly deprive a population of the means to survive strike at the most basic guarantees of the rights to life and diminish the core of human dignity,” the report reads. “The U.S. Government must cease all threats and hostile acts against Cuba’s sovereignty and revoke all measures it has imposed on the country that stand contrary to international law.”

sentences.en: “The humanitarian consequences are already unfolding into a full-blown crisis, threatening the rights to health, to life, to food and to development.…
sentences.zh: “人道主义后果已经演变成一场全面危机，威胁着健康权、生命权、食物权和发展权……

sentences.en: Measures that knowingly deprive a population of the means to survive strike at the most basic guarantees of the rights to life and diminish the core of human dignity,” the report reads.
sentences.zh: 故意剥夺人们生存手段的措施损害了生命权的最基本保障，削弱了人类尊严的核心，”报告写道。

sentences.en: “The U.S. Government must cease all threats and hostile acts against Cuba’s sovereignty and revoke all measures it has imposed on the country that stand contrary to international law.”
sentences.zh: “美国政府必须停止对古巴主权的一切威胁和敌对行为，并撤销对古巴实施的所有违反国际法的措施。”

blocks.html_en: President Donald Trump is seriously crashing out after a federal appeals court ordered him to stop illegal construction on his White House ballroom.

sentences.en: President Donald Trump is seriously crashing out after a federal appeals court ordered him to stop illegal construction on his White House ballroom.
sentences.zh: 在联邦上诉法院命令唐纳德·特朗普总统停止在白宫舞厅进行非法建筑后，他陷入了严重的崩溃。

blocks.html_en: In a furious screed on Truth Social Friday, Trump announced that he would immediately appeal the decision to the Supreme Court.

sentences.en: In a furious screed on Truth Social Friday, Trump announced that he would immediately appeal the decision to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在《真相社会星期五》上发表了一篇愤怒的长篇大论，宣布他将立即向最高法院上诉。

blocks.html_en: “The Military and Secret Service are viewing this horrendous, politically motivated, and unlawful ruling as a National Security threat to our Nation in that the entire Complex is being built for the protection of our Country and, additionally, all future Presidents,” the president wrote.

sentences.en: “The Military and Secret Service are viewing this horrendous, politically motivated, and unlawful ruling as a National Security threat to our Nation in that the entire Complex is being built for the protection of our Country and, additionally, all future Presidents,” the president wrote.
sentences.zh: 总统写道：“军方和特勤局将这一可怕的、出于政治动机的非法裁决视为对我们国家的国家安全威胁，因为整个建筑群的建造是为了保护我们的国家，此外也是为了保护所有未来的总统。”

blocks.html_en: Trump described his plans to build “one big, expensive, and very complex unit” that includes a state of the art hospital, bomb shelter, and a top secret military facility—well, not so secret anymore, I’d gather.

sentences.en: Trump described his plans to build “one big, expensive, and very complex unit” that includes a state of the art hospital, bomb shelter, and a top secret military facility—well, not so secret anymore, I’d gather.
sentences.zh: 特朗普描述了他建造“一个庞大、昂贵且非常复杂的单位”的计划，其中包括一家最先进的医院、防空洞和一个绝密军事设施——嗯，我猜，不再那么秘密了。

blocks.html_en: In a 2-1 ruling earlier Friday, a  D.C. Circuit Court panel determined the Trump administration must seek approval for construction from Congress, which has the “exclusive authority to regulate the construction and demolition of White House structures.”

sentences.en: In a 2-1 ruling earlier Friday, a D.C.
sentences.zh: 周五早些时候，华盛顿特区以 2-1 的比分做出了裁决。

sentences.en: Circuit Court panel determined the Trump administration must seek approval for construction from Congress, which has the “exclusive authority to regulate the construction and demolition of White House structures.”
sentences.zh: 巡回法院小组裁定，特朗普政府必须寻求国会的批准，因为国会拥有“监管白宫建筑的建造和拆除的专属权力”。

blocks.html_en: “At this preliminary stage, the National Trust has shown, compellingly, that Congress has not ceded unfettered authority to the Executive Branch to dramatically redesign, reshape, and reconstruct the White House—the People’s House—to fit a particular President’s desires,” the ruling stated.

sentences.en: “At this preliminary stage, the National Trust has shown, compellingly, that Congress has not ceded unfettered authority to the Executive Branch to dramatically redesign, reshape, and reconstruct the White House—the People’s House—to fit a particular President’s desires,” the ruling stated.
sentences.zh: 裁决称：“在这个初步阶段，国民信托基金已经令人信服地表明，国会没有将不受限制的权力让给行政部门，以大幅重新设计、重塑和重建白宫——人民之家——以满足特定总统的愿望。”

blocks.html_en: Trump-appointed Judge Neomi Rao dissented, agreeing with the administration that the National Trust for Historic Preservation did not have the standing to challenge the construction. The nonprofit’s case was centered around Professor Alison Hoagland, a member of the National Trust, who formally claimed that the ballroom was an aesthetic injury to the White House.

sentences.en: Trump-appointed Judge Neomi Rao dissented, agreeing with the administration that the National Trust for Historic Preservation did not have the standing to challenge the construction.
sentences.zh: 特朗普任命的法官内奥米·拉奥(Neomi Rao)持不同意见，他同意政府的观点，即国家历史保护信托基金没有资格质疑该建筑。

sentences.en: The nonprofit’s case was centered around Professor Alison Hoagland, a member of the National Trust, who formally claimed that the ballroom was an aesthetic injury to the White House.
sentences.zh: 该非营利组织的案件以国家信托基金成员艾莉森·霍格兰教授为中心，她正式声称舞厅对白宫的美观造成了损害。

blocks.html_en: Rao argued that the decision would “permit adjudication of any government action that a plaintiff finds unsightly.” But by the judge’s logic, the Trump administration could make unilateral sweeping changes to any national landmark—even, as the DOJ tried to claim, the Statue of Liberty.

sentences.zh: 但按照法官的逻辑，特朗普政府可以对任何国家地标进行单方面彻底改变——甚至正如司法部试图声称的那样，是自由女神像。

blocks.html_en: For months, Trump has treated the White House—which belongs to all Americans, not just the president—like one of his gaudy resort properties.

sentences.zh: 几个月来，特朗普一直把白宫——它属于所有美国人，而不仅仅是总统——当作他的一处华丽的度假胜地。

亚马逊正在悄悄尝试建造该国最大的天然气发电厂。

Distilled 时事通讯周五报道称，这家大型企业已在德克萨斯州佩科斯县购买了土地并获得了许可证，用于建设由一座 7.65 吉瓦燃气发电厂供电的人工智能数据中心。 许可证显示，该工厂将完全独立于德克萨斯州的电网，至少在一开始是这样。

据 Distilled 报道，这个名为 GW Ranch 的工厂获得了州许可，允许拟建发电厂排放 3300 万吨二氧化碳，这将使其成为美国最大的污染场所，排放量超过该国最大的燃煤发电厂。 这与亚马逊在气候承诺中承诺到 2040 年实现净零排放形成鲜明对比。

亚马逊本周向德克萨斯州提交了三份建筑许可证，一旦获得批准，将立即建造三座数据中心大楼。 根据卫星图像，土地清理工作已经开始。 亚马逊将加入微软、谷歌和 Meta 的行列，拥有自己的离网天然气发电。

亚马逊表示，该公司在 40 个项目中拥有 10 吉瓦的无碳能源，为德克萨斯州现有的数据中心运营提供动力，并且 GW 牧场将使用不可饮用的微咸地下水，因此不能用于灌溉或饮用。

但这不太可能平息公众的反对。 数据中心在全国各地的共和党人和民主党人中都非常不受欢迎，无论是在农村还是郊区。 这些中心不会创造很多就业机会或促进当地经济。 如果连接到当地电网，它们可能会提高公用事业费率并导致停电和限电。 在气候变化和干旱的背景下，数据中心将利用无法使用的水的说法可能会引起怀疑。

亚马逊正在为该项目建造自己的发电厂，这一事实对于担心公用事业费率的居民来说将是一个小小的安慰，但当地人仍然会对比美国其他任何其他发电厂都大的天然气发电厂造成的污染感到担忧。德克萨斯州农村地区是共和党的坚定支持者，尽管唐纳德·特朗普总统对数据中心的受欢迎程度抱有幻想，但右翼人士对数据中心的反对却在不断增长。 既然这个项目已经公开，很快就会出现强烈的反对声音。

去年，众议员马克斯·米勒(Max Miller)女儿因瘀伤被送往医院后，将责任归咎于日托所。

2025 年 2 月，米勒起诉俄亥俄州西湖市的一家日托服务提供者，此前他与前妻艾米丽·莫雷诺（俄亥俄州参议员伯尼·莫雷诺的女儿）的女儿被送往急诊室，“她的大腿、脸部、腹股沟和阴道部位受伤，导致她遭受心理创伤”。 1 月 27 日，一名日托工作人员向警方以及儿童和家庭服务部报警后，她的母亲将当时还不到两岁的女孩送往医​​院。

该诉讼没有明确说明她的伤势来自何处，米勒有一长串针对他的前妻和女儿的虐待指控，甚至据称导致女儿的锁骨骨折。 他在离婚最终确定前四个月提起诉讼，指控学校和四名点名员工“未能对员工进行适当培训和监督，以正确对待他们所照顾的儿童。 被告虐待并忽视了依赖他们保护的孩子。”

米勒是投诉中唯一点名的人，莫雷诺没有被提及。 米勒在诉讼中声称，县当局的调查支持了他的说法，并提供了记录涉嫌虐待和忽视的视频和音频证据。 学校否认了这些指控，称这名幼儿“在被告所谓的照顾和监督下没有受到任何形式的伤害、虐待或伤害”。

该案在四个月前被驳回，至于是否达成和解，目前尚未披露。 鉴于新披露的指控称米勒习惯将女儿心爱的蓝色兔子扣为人质，并且他承认自己在网上分享了一张女儿的不当照片，这起诉讼引发了更多问题。

根据国家妇女法律中心对美国劳工统计局最新的惨淡就业报告的分析，7 月份劳动力下降的原因是女性 100%。

总体而言，7 月份经济损失了 23,000 个工作岗位：女性失去了 32,000 个工作岗位，而男性增加了 9,000 个工作岗位。 失去的许多工作岗位来自地方政府、休闲和酒店业——这些工作是真正的女性所从事的，她们已经在应对工资放缓和通货膨胀上升的问题。

与此同时，上个月有多达 165,000 名女性退出劳动力市场，这意味着她们既没有工作也没有寻找新工作。 劳动力中的男性人数保持稳定。

NWLC 研究副总裁 Jasmine Tucker 警告说，最新的就业报告“并不是经济健康的迹象”。

“正在以惊人的数量离开劳动力市场的女性，许多仍然就业的女性却就业不足。 本届政府不能庆祝一个令如此多女性失望的经济，”塔克说。

事实上，自今年年初以来，离开劳动力市场的女性人数是男性的两倍多。 自一月份以来，共有 845,000 名女性离开劳动力市场，而 406,000 名男性则离开劳动力市场。

很难不将这些令人震惊的统计数据视为特朗普政府破坏妇女权利和自主权的更广泛运动的一部分。

无论是让女性更难投票，让女性在职业上边缘化，还是危及紧急怀孕护理——以女性生计为目标，感觉就像是按照设计的那样运作的系统的一部分。

马可·卢比奥正在慢慢地把古巴掐死。

国务卿告诉 Axios，他计划永久接管该岛，该岛长期以来一直受到美国情报机构的干预和广泛的联邦制裁的困扰。

“我们试图告诉他们的是，没有逃生阀…… 每次他们创建一种新机制试图摆脱绞索时，我们都会将其关闭，”卢比奥说。 “他们当然不能等我们出去。 当然，这种情况在未来[两年半]内不会消失。”

特朗普政府一直对古巴保持着密切的关注，从一月份导致停电的石油封锁开始，直接导致了广泛的粮食不安全、经济崩溃和死亡，岛上婴儿死亡率翻了一番。 美国对古巴发动了 24 次不同的攻击，包括指责古巴的医生出口计划涉及人口贩运、声称古巴协助国际恐怖主义，以及针对西方意识形态开展“非常规和秘密”的行动。 军事行动仍然是可能的。

卢比奥周四宣布：“古巴共产主义政权是恐怖主义的国家支持者，它对美国进行间谍活动，向暴力左翼激进分子提供武器，传播有毒的马克思主义意识形态，并成为距离我们海岸仅 90 英里的俄罗斯、中国和伊朗的集结地。” “今天，我制裁了与为该政权采购武器有关的五个古巴实体和八个个人。 正如特朗普总统所说：美国不会容忍一个流氓国家在我们家门口窝藏敌对军事、情报和恐怖活动。 任何支持、赞助或向这些受制裁行为者提供服务的人都面临着受到制裁的风险。”

特朗普政府（特别是卢比奥）正在依靠冷战和红色恐慌言论来证明古巴持续存在全面人道主义危机的合理性。 周四，即卢比奥宣布这一消息的同一天，也是最近一次全国停电的四天后，人权理事会任命的一个独立专家小组宣布古巴面临成为“沉默的加沙”的风险。

“人道主义后果已经演变成一场全面危机，威胁着健康权、生命权、食物权和发展权…… 故意剥夺人们生存手段的措施损害了生命权的最基本保障，削弱了人类尊严的核心，”报告写道。 “美国政府必须停止对古巴主权的一切威胁和敌对行为，并撤销对古巴实施的所有违反国际法的措施。”

编辑精选

在联邦上诉法院命令唐纳德·特朗普总统停止在白宫舞厅进行非法建筑后，他陷入了严重的崩溃。

特朗普在《真相社会星期五》上发表了一篇愤怒的长篇大论，宣布他将立即向最高法院上诉。

总统写道：“军方和特勤局将这一可怕的、出于政治动机的非法裁决视为对我们国家的国家安全威胁，因为整个建筑群的建造是为了保护我们的国家，此外也是为了保护所有未来的总统。”

特朗普描述了他建造“一个庞大、昂贵且非常复杂的单位”的计划，其中包括一家最先进的医院、防空洞和一个绝密军事设施——嗯，我猜，不再那么秘密了。

周五早些时候，华盛顿特区以 2-1 的比分做出了裁决。 巡回法院小组裁定，特朗普政府必须寻求国会的批准，因为国会拥有“监管白宫建筑的建造和拆除的专属权力”。

裁决称：“在这个初步阶段，国民信托基金已经令人信服地表明，国会没有将不受限制的权力让给行政部门，以大幅重新设计、重塑和重建白宫——人民之家——以满足特定总统的愿望。”

特朗普任命的法官内奥米·拉奥(Neomi Rao)持不同意见，他同意政府的观点，即国家历史保护信托基金没有资格质疑该建筑。 该非营利组织的案件以国家信托基金成员艾莉森·霍格兰教授为中心，她正式声称舞厅对白宫的美观造成了损害。

拉奥辩称，该决定将“允许对原告认为不雅观的任何政府行为进行裁决”。 但按照法官的逻辑，特朗普政府可以对任何国家地标进行单方面彻底改变——甚至正如司法部试图声称的那样，是自由女神像。

几个月来，特朗普一直把白宫——它属于所有美国人，而不仅仅是总统——当作他的一处华丽的度假胜地。

与此同时，特朗普舞厅的价格已经飙升。 总统最初声称他的宴会厅项目只需花费 2 亿美元，但这个数字后来飙升至 3 亿美元，在他决定增加额外建设后又增加到 4 亿美元。 6 月，一份爆炸性报告显示，预计纳税人将承担 6 亿美元总成本中的一半费用。

这个故事已经更新。
